title: Tarka dal with roasted cauliflower
summary: Tarka dal with roasted cauliflower is a indian dinner built around dried red lentils and cauliflower, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Heat the fan oven to 200°C. Cut the vegetables for Tarka dal with roasted cauliflower into even pieces and toss cauliflower with a teaspoon of the oil and a pinch of salt in the tin.
steps.tip: Even pieces cook at the same rate, so nothing is burnt while something else is still raw.

steps.instruction: Roast that first tray of cauliflower while you season dried red lentils. Pat it dry so the surface browns instead of steaming.
Nestle dried red lentils and onions among the vegetables. Roast until the protein is cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
steps.tip: Taste Tarka dal with roasted cauliflower before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Rest the tin for a few minutes, taste, and spoon Tarka dal with roasted cauliflower into warm bowls with the juices.
